goal: Introduce a small helper class to host Elements' private helper logic (siblings and childNodesOfType). Keep the existing Elements class unchanged in this step.

ops.details: Create a new helper class org.jsoup.select.ElementsHelper in the same package. The class provides two package-visible static methods mirroring the behavior of the current private helpers in Elements: siblings(Elements elements, String query, boolean next, boolean all) and <T extends org.jsoup.nodes.Node> List<T> childNodesOfType(Elements elements, Class<T> tClass). Implementation should be a near-copy of the existing private methods, but accept the calling Elements instance as the first parameter. Add necessary imports: java.util.ArrayList, java.util.List, java.util.HashSet/LinkedHashSet only if used; use org.jsoup.nodes.Node and org.jsoup.nodes.Element and org.jsoup.select.Selector/Evaluator as needed. Do not modify Elements.java in this op.
